description: Source code for UART backend implementation of EC host command handling in Zephyr OS, including UART event handling, state management, and initialization.

methods.name: request_expected_size
methods.description: Calculates expected size of host command request based on header.

methods.name: rx_timeout
methods.description: Handles UART receive timeout, logs errors, and resets UART reception.

methods.name: uart_callback
methods.description: UART event handler managing reception, transmission, and errors.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_uart_init
methods.description: Initializes UART backend, sets buffers, and enables UART reception.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_uart_send
methods.description: Sends response over UART and manages state transitions.
